nobody: nobody — dice belong to no one
nobodyNote: dice belong to no one: roll edits and “after seeing the dice” questions do not apply to them

ownDie.fromInput: die from the input “{{name}}”: the faces rolled are added up, it has no success rule
ownDie.written: die “{{name}}”: the faces rolled are added up, it has no success rule

who.stray: {{name}} — there is no such sheet here
who.label: Who rolls
who.title: Who rolls — their roll is affected by edits (advantage, “Bless”) and “after seeing the dice” questions.

shift.label: Adjustment to the field number
shift.placeholder: for example +20 for an easy task

fixed: the step still has the formula “{{expr}}” — it will be removed once you choose what is rolled

tags.label: Tags
tags.title: Edits and triggers find a roll by its tags; a tag is a row of any table in the system

result.forked: this step’s branch already goes by “{{name}}”
result.renameTitle: this is what the step result is called in formulas — click to rename
result.name: result…
result.lockedTitle: this is what the step result is called in formulas; steps below already refer to this name, so it cannot be renamed
result.nameTitle: this is what the roll result is called in formulas, and its parts after a dot

where.passWith: check · always a success with margin

meaning.success: yes or no — the outcome of this check
meaning.margin: number — the margin over this check’s threshold

versus.label: Against
versus.placeholder: threshold: a number, a field through a sheet, or an opponent’s roll

inside: the roll “{{name}}” stands inside a formula: “success on the die”, threshold shift and recalculation of “against” edits for each target do not apply to such a comparison

degrees.label: Margins
degrees.hint: Instead of “yes/no” the outcome is read by margins: the first one that fits from the top. Conditions can see “success”, “margin” and the effect’s steps.

succeedOn.label: Success if the die shows at least
succeedOn.hint: If the die shows this or more — success, whatever is added.

failOn.label: Failure if the die shows at most
failOn.hint: A natural 1: whatever is added — failure.

failIf.label: Always a failure if
failIf.hint: A yes/no condition: if true — failure, whatever is rolled.

passWith.label: Always a success with margin
passWith.hint: A number: the check passes with this margin over the threshold.

against.many: “against” edits do not apply to this comparison: the threshold names more than one sheet

contest.title: Opposed roll: the result of one roll is compared with the result of another. A roll above “For each of” is one for all; below it — each target has its own.
